description: This file is a shell script named 'clawlog.sh' that serves as a command-line utility for accessing and filtering logs related to VibeTunnel/OpenClaw on macOS. It provides functionalities such as filtering logs by categories, search terms, log level, time ranges, and output options, with features like real-time streaming and exporting logs to a file.

methods.name: handle_sudo_error
methods.description: Displays instructions for resolving sudo password issues when accessing logs.

methods.name: show_usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and command options for the clawlog utility.

methods.name: list_categories
methods.description: Lists recent log categories related to VibeTunnel by querying recent log entries.

methods.name: escape_predicate_literal
methods.description: Escapes special characters in user input for safe inclusion in log predicates.
